lines.text: What would you do if you woke up *tomorrow*...
and your forty-page *textbook* chapter...
turned into *TikToks*?
Imagine. It's *7 AM*. Bio test. *Today*.
You open the chapter, and your brain goes *blank*.
Total *panic*.
Memory search: chapter four. Absolutely *nothing*.
Then your phone *buzzes*.
Wait. It's the *chapter*!
Same facts. Same diagrams. Somehow *transformed* overnight.
At first, you think it's a *gimmick*.
But every reel ends with a *quiz*. And you *get it*.
So you scroll at *breakfast*. Mom thinks nothing's *unusual*.
But the *funniest* part?
You still act exactly the *same*. Same couch. Same snacks. Same *scrolling*.
Except now, you actually *remember* it.
Then the test comes back, and everyone treats you *differently*.
Your best friend has one *question*.
Would you share it with your *best friend*?
What would *you* do? Try it *free* at unspool dot cc.
